headline: JPMorgan Stock Rises As Investors Rotate Into Financials
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co (NYSE: JPM) shares are trading higher Thursday as traders rotate out of tech and into financials.

headline: JPMorgan: CLARITY Act Has Only A Narrow Window To Succeed, Timing Is 'Pivotal'
summary: JPMorgan Chase warned that the crypto industry's long-awaited Clarity Act faces a narrowing path to passage as midterm-election politics and disagreements over stablecoin yields create new obstacles. The biggest sticking point remains whether stablecoin issuers can offer yield-like products.

headline: 'JPMorgan, Jefferies Plan Venezuela Trips as Investors Rush In' - Bloomberg
Jamie Dimon Pitches SpaceX IPO To 2,500 Wealthy JPMorgan Clients Thursday
summary: Jamie Dimon will personally pitch the SpaceX IPO to 2,500 wealthy JPMorgan clients Thursday, while Robinhood traders face lottery odds for the same shares.
